subtitulo: I am Lourdes Cusihuaman Gálvez, former SUNAT tax officer. I put my experience at your service to resolve your tax doubts, protect your money, and give you complete peace of mind with your filings and notices.
motivos_titulo: HOW CAN I HELP YOU WITH SUNAT TODAY?
info_ansiedad: I help you issue fee receipts accurately, file Form 1609 to prevent the 8% tax withholding, and claim your tax refunds.
info_pareja: I calculate your precise payroll withholdings and show you how to deduct up to 3 additional UITs to lower your taxes.
info_apoyo: I review bank and transfer notifications directly with you, write formal response letters, and prevent penalties.
driver_card_desc: I personally evaluate your case online or in-person in my Surquillo office.
